landmarks.name: National Park of American Samoa
landmarks.writeup: A protected area encompassing tropical rainforests, coral reefs, and volcanic mountains, showcasing the islands' natural beauty and biodiversity.

landmarks.name: Pago Pago Harbor
landmarks.writeup: A deep natural harbor surrounded by volcanic mountains, serving as a key port and scenic spot.

landmarks.name: Jean P. Haydon Museum
landmarks.writeup: A museum dedicated to preserving and showcasing the cultural and historical heritage of American Samoa.

head_of_state: President of the United States (Joe Biden)

cultural_events.name: Ava Ceremony
cultural_events.writeup: A traditional Samoan ritual involving the preparation and drinking of ava (kava), symbolizing respect and social hierarchy.

cultural_events.name: Flag Day
cultural_events.writeup: An annual celebration on April 17th commemorating the cession of the islands to the United States, featuring parades, cultural performances, and sports.

food_writeup: American Samoan cuisine blends Polynesian traditions with American influences, featuring dishes like palusami (taro leaves with coconut cream), oka i'a (raw fish salad), and various seafood prepared with local ingredients.
brief_history: American Samoa became a U.S. territory in 1900 following agreements with local chiefs and the U.S. government. It has since maintained a unique cultural identity while under American administration.

important_people.name: Eni Faleomavaega
important_people.description: Former Delegate to the U.S. House of Representatives

current_conflicts: No significant internal or external conflicts reported.
